subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the sales of bikes and cars of five companies L, M, N, P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29598f0db4c113b5ca93ed612442580cd810b722183994f6274db8c8ae70b04a.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The sales of bikes of company L and M together is 45.88 percent of the sales of cars of company P and Q together.

II. The total sales of bikes is 77.5 percent of the total sales of cars.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Checking Statement I:

The sales of bikes of company L and M together = 500 + 450 = 950

The sales of cars of company P and Q together = 900 + 800 = 1700

Now, % = frac {950}{1700} times 100\% ≈ 55.88%

Hence, the sales of bikes of company L and M together is NOT 45.88% of the sales of cars of company P and Q together.</p
